variable_coverage.construction: Public Market Dummy: Binary indicator equal to 1 if the firm borrows in the public debt market and 0 if it borrows from private lenders. The selected specification uses either each issue (Model 1) or a unique firm-year (Model 2) as its observation. Source formula: 1 if public-market borrowing; 0 if private-lender borrowing.. Required local/source resources: R-BONDS; R-LOANS; R-IDENTIFIER-LINKS. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

First-Time Mandatory: Indicator for firms that never reported under IFRS before mandatory adoption; equals 1 for firm-years ending on or after the local mandate date and 0 otherwise. Source formula: 1 if first-time mandatory IFRS adopter firm-year ends on/after local mandate date; 0 otherwise.. Required local/source resources: R-IFRS-STATUS-HISTORY; R-IFRS-MANDATE-DATES. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

Voluntary: Indicator for voluntary IFRS adopters; equals 1 for firm-years with IFRS reporting by voluntary adopters and 0 otherwise. Source formula: 1 for voluntary-adopter firm-years; 0 otherwise.. Required local/source resources: R-IFRS-STATUS-HISTORY; R-IFRS-MANDATE-DATES. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

Voluntary × Mandatory: Interaction between Voluntary adoption and the Mandatory indicator for voluntary adopters after the local mandate date. Source formula: Voluntary_t × Mandatory_t.. Required local/source resources: R-IFRS-STATUS-HISTORY; R-IFRS-MANDATE-DATES. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

Leverage: Long-term debt divided by total assets. Source formula: Long-term debt (WS03251) / total assets (WS02999).. Required local/source resources: R-WS-ANNUAL. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

Size: Natural log of total assets in dollars. Source formula: ln(total assets in $; WS07230).. Required local/source resources: R-WS-ANNUAL. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

Tangibility: Net property, plant, and equipment divided by total assets. Source formula: Net PP&E (WS02501) / total assets (WS02999).. Required local/source resources: R-WS-ANNUAL. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

Market to book: Firm market value divided by book value of total assets. The appendix defines market value as total assets less book equity plus market equity, and identifies the denominator as total assets (Worldscope WS02999). Source formula: (WS02999 − WS03501 + WS08001) / WS02999.. Required local/source resources: R-WS-ANNUAL; R-WS-MARKETCAP. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

ROA: Earnings before interest and tax divided by total assets. Source formula: EBIT (WS18191) / total assets (WS02999).. Required local/source resources: R-WS-ANNUAL. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

Returns: Natural log of the monthly Return Index ratio over the prior 12 months; RI is the Datastream Monthly Return Index observed on the first day of the month. Source formula: ln(RI_t / RI_{t−12}).. Required local/source resources: R-DATASTREAM-RI; R-IDENTIFIER-LINKS. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

Returns variability: Standard deviation of the Monthly Return Index over the fiscal year. Source formula: SD of the Monthly Return Index over the fiscal year.. Required local/source resources: R-DATASTREAM-RI; R-IDENTIFIER-LINKS. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

O-Score: Ohlson’s (1980) default-risk measure, using natural log total assets, total liabilities/assets, working capital/assets, current liabilities/current assets, an indicator for total liabilities exceeding total assets, and scaled change in net income. The source PDF prints “to” between the −1.32 intercept and the 0.407 total-assets coefficient, leaving that arithmetic operator unresolved. Source formula: not uniquely calculable: the original Appendix prints “to” between −1.32 and 0.407, and its intended arithmetic operator is unresolved in the provided PDF.. Required local/source resources: R-WS-ANNUAL. Candidate live fields and unresolved semantic, date, identifier and coverage mappings are recorded on the requirements.

Investment grade: Indicator equal to 1 when the Standard & Poor’s or estimated firm credit rating is investment grade (BBB− or higher), and 0 otherwise. implementation_issues.description: The O-Score formula in the original Appendix visibly prints “to” between the −1.32 intercept and the 0.407 log-assets term. The source’s arithmetic operator is unresolved, so the frozen construction cannot be uniquely calculated without choosing an unsupported formula.

The source defines the issue-level repeated-issue screen as deleting same-type issues by the same firm within one year but does not identify which issue is retained. For firm-year Public Market Dummy it does not state how a year with both bond and loan borrowing is coded; the continuous amount ratio also lacks a currency-normalization rule.

evidence.quote: We obtain our sample from public bond issues and private loan arrangements completed by listed nonfinancial firms for the 2000–2007 period
evidence.description: The paper sets the full-sample debt observation years and listed nonfinancial borrower population.

evidence.quote: Our public debt data come from Securities Data Company’s (SDC) Platinum database,
evidence.description: The paper identifies SDC Platinum as the global public-bond source.

evidence.quote: Using several company identifiers (i.e., ISIN, CUSIP, and ticker symbol) and company name, we successfully match
evidence.description: The paper describes matching SDC issuers to Worldscope using ISIN, CUSIP, ticker and name.

evidence.quote: we exclude convertible bonds and bonds with callable features
evidence.description: The public-bond selection excludes convertibles and callable bonds.

evidence.quote: for each issue, we generate a dummy variable, Public Market Dummy, that equals 1 if a firm borrows in the public market and 0 if it borrows from private lenders
evidence.description: The issue-level dependent-variable definition and coding.

evidence.quote: after deleting debt issues of the same type by the same firm within 1 year
evidence.description: The issue-level sample applies this within-firm/type one-year screen.

evidence.quote: a probit regression on the total sample of bonds and loans with 13,546 observations
evidence.description: The issue-level access model sample size after its fixed-effect prediction losses.

evidence.quote: a firm-level analysis by estimating Eq. (1) in two ways: (a) by probit regression on a sample of 12,123 unique firm-years
evidence.description: The firm-year probit model uses 12,123 unique firm-years.

evidence.quote: by OLS on a sample of 12,574 unique firm-years with a continuous dependent variable, Public Market Continuous, calculated for each firm-year as the ratio between the total amount of public debt and the total amount of public and private debt issued in a particular year
evidence.description: The continuous outcome aggregates amounts at firm-year level and uses 12,574 observations.

evidence.quote: The value of this variable ranges from 0 (i.e., the firm obtains only new loans in a particular year) to 1 (i.e., the firm issues only new bonds in a particular year)
evidence.description: The continuous outcome ranges from all-private to all-public new borrowing.

evidence.quote: We identify IFRS adopters based on the reporting standards used in each firm-year (Worldscope item 07536) and the coding established by Daske et al. (2012).
evidence.description: IFRS adoption status uses Worldscope item 07536 and external coding.

evidence.quote: First-Time Mandatory, which refers to observations of firms that did not report under IFRS before the mandatory adoption.
evidence.description: The first-time mandatory classification needs pre-mandate firm reporting history.

evidence.quote: Firm-specific variables come from Worldscope; we obtain GDP Growth and Country Rating data from World Bank and Standard & Poor’s Sovereign Ratings, respectively;
evidence.description: The paper identifies Worldscope, World Bank GDP growth and S&P sovereign ratings as variable sources.

evidence.quote: In all models under Eqs. (1) and (2), we include country- and industry-year fixed effects
evidence.description: Country and joint industry-year fixed effects are included.

evidence.quote: All empirical specifications are estimated with White standard errors, adjusted to account for correlations within country-year clusters
evidence.description: Inference uses White heteroskedasticity correction with country-year clustering.

evidence.quote: we winsorize continuous variables at the 1st and 99th percentiles
evidence.description: Continuous variables are winsorized at the first and ninety-ninth percentiles.

evidence.quote: We obtain private debt data from Dealscan, which provides detailed information on pricing and other loan terms worldwide.
evidence.description: The paper identifies Dealscan as the global private-loan source.

evidence.quote: We consider each facility as a separate observation, since loan characteristics (e.g., the cost of debt, maturity) can vary across facilities.
evidence.description: A Dealscan facility, rather than a loan package, is the paper’s observation unit.

evidence.quote: We first use ticker symbol, which is the only company identifier provided by Dealscan, to match its population to Worldscope.
evidence.description: Dealscan matching uses ticker and then company name.

evidence.quote: we select all senior loans, and we restrict the sample to term loans, revolvers, and 364-day facilities
evidence.description: The loan population is screened to senior term loans, revolvers and 364-day facilities.

evidence.quote: Final sample for access to debt 4676
evidence.description: Table 1 reports 4,676 bonds in the access-to-debt sample.

evidence.quote: Final sample for access to debt 9327
evidence.description: Table 1 reports 9,327 loans in the access-to-debt sample.

evidence.quote: Market to book = (WS02999 - WS03501 + WS08001)/WS02999
evidence.description: The coordinator-verified appendix transcription identifies Worldscope item 08001 as the market-equity input and retains item 02999 as the denominator.

evidence.quote: Long-term debt (WS03251) divided by total assets (WS02999)
evidence.description: The appendix supplies Worldscope item-code definitions for debt and total assets.

evidence.quote: Natural log of (RIt/RIt-12), where RI is the Datastream Monthly Return Index on the first day of the month
evidence.description: Returns is a twelve-month log change in Datastream RI, sampled on the first day of the month.

evidence.quote: The standard deviation of the Monthly Return Index
evidence.description: Return variability uses monthly index values over the fiscal year.

evidence.quote: Binary indicator variable that equals 1 if a firm has had a prior access public debt issue and 0 otherwise
evidence.description: Capital Market Access requires prior public-issue history.

evidence.quote: estimated credit rating (Rating) is investment grade
evidence.description: Investment Grade can use an observed S&P rating or the paper’s estimated rating.

evidence.quote: This equation is estimated crosssectionally and year-by-year
evidence.description: The firm-rating support equation is estimated separately by calendar year across a cross-section.

evidence.quote: An estimate is transformed into a rating by rounding to the nearest whole number with a minimum of 2 and maximum of 27
evidence.description: The fitted rating is rounded and clipped to the 2–27 scale.
